newsitem.title: GERMANY: KLM plans 10-12pct ex-Germany rates hike.
newsitem.headline: KLM plans 10-12pct ex-Germany rates hike.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV said it plans to raise ex-Germany air cargo rates by 10-12 percent early next year.
Oliver Evans, sales director Central & Eastern Europe, said the planned increase would follow a general five percent increase this October.
"We plan to go ahead with rates incrase in the first quarter of 1997. We anticipate an increase of probably 10-12 percent," he told Reuters in an interview.
"We anticipate healthy demand in 1997 and we intend to adjust prices to compensate for the situation in early 1996 when our tariffs were reduced to remain competitive," he added.
Air cargo rates in Germany fell considerably in the spring and summer but have recovered this autumn, industry observers said.

Market leader Lufthansa Cargo AG announced on November 29 it planned a seven percent rates rise next March and a second increase by next September. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax=44-171-542-5017
